translatedData.title: After 4 Years of Sticking Through the Bear Market, a 90% Surge! How DUSK's 'Technical Compounding' Can Help You Lock in Long-Term Gains
translatedData.subTitle: The biggest surprise in the crypto market at the beginning of 2026 is undoubtedly the 90% surge of DUSK in a single day! However, this wave of market movement is by no means a coincidence — the Dusk Foundation (@dusk_foundation) started in the bear market of 2018. When most projects went to zero and ran away, the team insisted on self-developing the Piecrust zero-knowledge virtual machine. Code submissions on GitHub have never been interrupted, and even during the deepest bear market in 2022, they maintained a code update frequency of over 15 times per month. This kind of 'technical compounding' has finally exploded: after the DuskEVM mainnet went live in the second week of January, it supports instant deployment of Solidity contracts, with Layer 1 settlement TPS reaching over 1200 (6 times that of Ethereum's mainnet); the waiting list for DuskTrade will open in January, bringing €300M of tokenized securities on-chain, further backed by a strategic investment endorsement from iFinex (the parent company of Tether).
